# Contributing to MeowRobot

Thank you for your interest in contributing to MeowRobot!

## Guidelines
- Follow PEP 8 style conventions for Python code.
- Test your changes before submitting pull requests.
- Ensure all environment variables are documented.

## Submitting Pull Requests
1. Fork repository or create feature branch.
2. Commit your improvements.
3. Submit a pull request with descriptive title.

## Code Quality
- Keep pull requests focused on a single feature or bug fix.
- Document any new environment variables or config settings.
